title: Jad workspace.json (workspace layout)
description: W/.jad/workspace.json turns the workspace layout on for a server started in W (docs/design_workspace_layout.md): W keeps its sessions (W/.jad/sessions), profiles (W/.jad/profiles), private models and tools (W/.jad/models, W/.jad/tools) and state (W/.jad/state); the shared catalogs come from the global folder (global.schema.json). A W/.jad/setting.json is then not read. Read once at start. Deleting this file goes back to the setting.json layout. An unknown key is refused; for the start workspace that refuses the start, for a listed one it skips the workspace.

id.description: The workspace id when global.json does not list this workspace (default: the folder name made an id). When it is listed, the id must be the listed one.

defaults.description: Setting values every session of this workspace starts from, over global.json defaults. A relative env_file is relative to W/.jad, a relative cwd to W; without any cwd a session works in W. A profile may tighten, never loosen, the caps and an enabled sandbox set here or in global.json.

libraries.description: The workspace's own content library, seen only by this workspace: folders relative to this file's folder (W/.jad), read once at start, listed after the global ones. None by default. A skill or command name also in the global library is left out and naming it is an error; prompts and templates of both are listed side by side.

profile_self_edit.description: The profile_self_edit level of this workspace: off, on or full (see global.schema.json). It can only lower the level of G/global.json (on when unset): a workspace that sets full while global.json does not stays on.
